in_marathi.name: Barani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Barani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Barani is a Sanskrit word that translates to rain or monsoon in English. It is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'Barh', which means 'to expand'. In Hindu mythology, Barani represents the monsoon season, which brings life and fertility to the land.
